linesZhTw: 的面積好像又變大了…這裡
linesZhCn: 的面积好像又变大了…这里
linesEn: Huh? I haven't been through here in a while, but the marsh seems even wider...
This area was supposed to still be a forest.
A swamp swallowing a forest? I've never heard of such a thing.

linesZhTw: 『這個死之沼澤是全大陸邪氣
最重的地方，什麼事情都有
可能發生，大家要特別小心
linesZhCn: 『这个死之沼泽是全大陆邪气
最重的地方，什么事情都有
可能发生，大家要特别小心
linesEn: This Swamp of Death holds the foulest evil aura on the entire continent.
Anything could happen here. Everyone, be on high alert...
...Watch your step.
Quiet! I hear sounds of battle ahead!
Damn it... So the rumors were true after all...

linesZhTw: 居然真有看不見的怪物！』
linesZhCn: 居然真有看不见的怪物！』
linesEn: I still can't believe it... Invisible monsters really exist in this world?!
You just took a bite from one! Face reality!
Heh, give up! You've only yourselves to blame for wandering into this swamp!
The boss's orders are clear: anyone who sets foot in this swamp dies!
Shadow, what should we do now?!
...We fight our way through!
Then perish where you stand!

linesZhTw: 到了看不見的隱形怪物呢！
linesZhCn: 到了看不见的隐形怪物呢！
linesEn: From the sound of it, they're fighting invisible monsters!
Such creatures exist? That poses a grave threat to our crossing. Hmm...

linesZhTw: 『不如我們現在就出去和他們
攜手作戰，強行越過這沼澤
linesZhCn: 『不如我们现在就出去和他们
携手作战，强行越过这沼泽
linesEn: Why not step in and fight alongside them? We can force our way across the marsh,
and uncover the truth behind these invisible beasts...
...and learn what we're up against!

linesZhTw: 方攻擊，這可不是我們的一
linesZhCn: 方攻击，这可不是我们的一
linesEn: I agree! Standing by while travelers are attacked isn't our way!

linesZhTw: 不過對手中有看不見的傢伙
linesZhCn: 不过对手中有看不见的家伙
linesEn: Then let us join the fray! But with unseen foes lurking, everyone stay sharp!
...Curse it all... To fall to scum like this...
Aaaargh...!
The Tower of Holy Spirits... We cannot let the enemy enter...
Must... protect... the Tower of Holy Spirits...
Aaaargh...!
The Tower of Holy Spirits... We cannot let the enemy breach it...
Aaaargh...!
Must... defend... the Tower of Holy Spirits...
Aaaagh...!
Damn it, the elves have all been wiped out!

linesZhTw: 庇佑我們獲得最後的勝利。
對了，你們是怎麼碰上這件
linesZhCn: 庇佑我们获得最后的胜利。
对了，你们是怎么碰上这件
linesEn: A bitter struggle, but by the gods' grace we have prevailed.
Tell me, how did you come to face such strange perils?
...What happened here?

linesZhTw: 遭到這些傢伙和隱形的沼澤
怪物攻擊，幸好各位趕來援
linesZhCn: 遭到这些家伙和隐形的沼泽
怪物攻击，幸好各位赶来援
linesEn: We were passing through when these rogues and unseen swamp monsters ambushed us.
Had you not arrived in time, we would have perished here in confusion.

linesZhTw: 助，不然我們大概已經不明
linesZhCn: 助，不然我们大概已经不明
linesEn: ...We owe you our lives.

linesZhTw: 『為何那些傢伙要封鎖死之沼
澤？想要阻止我們前往北方
linesZhCn: 『为何那些家伙要封锁死之沼
泽？想要阻止我们前往北方
linesEn: Why did they blockade the Swamp of Death? Were they trying to stop us from heading north?

linesZhTw: 『可能和來路不明的黑暗軍進
linesZhCn: 『可能和来路不明的黑暗军进
linesEn: It may be related to the unknown Dark Army attacking the Tower of Holy Spirits...
What? Can that truly be?

linesZhTw: 在亞述森林，世代負責守護
聖地。最近集結的黑暗軍似
linesZhCn: 在亚述森林，世代负责守护
圣地。最近集结的黑暗军似
linesEn: Yes. Our elven clan dwells in Ashur Forest, guarding the sacred grounds for generations.
Recently, the gathering Dark Army seemed intent on attacking the Tower of Holy Spirits.

linesZhTw: 想進攻聖靈之塔，長老深恐
我們的兵力抵敵不住，所以
派遣我們向哈斯米爾求救，
linesZhCn: 想进攻圣灵之塔，长老深恐
我们的兵力抵敌不住，所以
派遣我们向哈斯米尔求救，
linesEn: Fearing our forces could not hold them, our elder dispatched us to Hasmir for help.
Little did we suspect the enemy had already laid an ambush here...

linesZhTw: 沒想到敵方已在此布下陷阱
linesZhCn: 没想到敌方已在此布下陷阱
linesEn: ...We walked right into their trap.

linesZhTw: 值得那些傢伙拼命進攻？』
linesZhCn: 值得那些家伙拼命进攻？』
linesEn: What secret does the Tower of Holy Spirits hold to warrant such a desperate assault?

linesZhTw: 有數百年沒人進去過了……
不過長老深信黑暗軍一旦攻
linesZhCn: 有数百年没人进去过了……
不过长老深信黑暗军一旦攻
linesEn: We do not know either. No one has set foot inside for hundreds of years...
Yet our elder believes that if the Dark Army claims it, the realm is doomed.

linesZhTw: 佔聖靈之塔，後果一定不堪
設想，所以嚴令我們務必死
linesZhCn: 占圣灵之塔，后果一定不堪
设想，所以严令我们务必死
linesEn: ...That is why we were strictly ordered to defend it to our dying breath.

linesZhTw: 敵方攻擊而死傷慘重，救兵
可以不必去求了，我們這就
linesZhCn: 敌方攻击而死伤惨重，救兵
可以不必去求了，我们这就
linesEn: I see. Hasmir has also been assaulted and suffered heavy casualties.
There are no reinforcements to be found there. We shall march to Ashur Forest instead!
...We will reinforce the elves ourselves!
Thank you so much! Now we can return and report to the elder with peace of mind!

linesZhTw: 這個職業現在已經不多見了
linesZhCn: 这个职业现在已经不多见了
linesEn: Hmm. You appear to be a ninja. That calling is exceedingly rare nowadays...
What are your plans now?

linesZhTw: 些年來的和平生活，讓我以
為這一身技藝已經沒有用了
linesZhCn: 些年来的和平生活，让我以
为这一身技艺已经没有用了
linesEn: I have lived in seclusion in this forest for years.
All this peace made me think my skills were no longer of any use.

linesZhTw: 是錯了…如果你們不介意的
話，我願意加入你們，與黑
linesZhCn: 是错了…如果你们不介意的
话，我愿意加入你们，与黑
linesEn: Now I see how mistaken I was... If you don't mind, I would gladly join you
and fight the Dark Army to the bitter end!
...Let me stand with you!

linesZhTw: 也不會嫌夠的。歡迎加入！
linesZhCn: 也不会嫌够的。欢迎加入！
linesEn: When facing the Dark Army, one can never have too many hands. Welcome aboard!

linesZhTw: 新人了，事態緊急，我們得
linesZhCn: 新人了，事态紧急，我们得
linesEn: Regrettably, there is no time for welcomes. The situation is dire—
we must head for Ashur Forest at once.
Understood! Let's move out!
Gah-hoo-zhee! Shee-lee-hoo-ka-loo...!
Is that not a lesser demon? What is it doing here?

linesZhTw: 『看起來好像沒有敵意的樣子
linesZhCn: 『看起来好像没有敌意的样子
linesEn: It doesn't seem hostile, but alas, I cannot understand the demonic tongue...
What are you saying? I can't quite hear you. Just a moment.
Gah-hoo-zhee! Shee-lee-hoo-ka-loo...!
Mm, yes... I understand. I will plead your case to the others.
Uni, you understand its words?!

linesZhTw: 麼，不過我不知道為何我聽
linesZhCn: 么，不过我不知道为何我听
linesEn: Yes, I understand what he is saying, though I have no idea why I can...
Do not worry, Lady Uni. What did he tell you?

linesZhTw: 魔族戰士，因為對首領的命
令產生了懷疑，而被處以監
linesZhCn: 魔族战士，因为对首领的命
令产生了怀疑，而被处以监
linesEn: He says his name is Darkseid, a warrior of the lesser demons.
He began to question his leader's orders and was imprisoned as punishment.

linesZhTw: 禁的刑罰，原先是由「死亡
骷髏」所看管，後來我們打
倒了負責防守死之沼澤的敵
linesZhCn: 禁的刑罚，原先是由「死亡
骷髅」所看管，后来我们打
倒了负责防守死之沼泽的敌
linesEn: He was guarded by the Death Skulls, but when we defeated the forces
guarding the Swamp of Death, he slipped away in the confusion.
...That was how he escaped.

linesZhTw: 這位達克塞先生對我們有何
linesZhCn: 这位达克塞先生对我们有何
linesEn: Demons are involved in this as well? That is even more troublesome than I imagined...
And what does this Master Darkseid want from us?
...What is his request?

linesZhTw: 『他說魔族已遭人以某種方式
操縱，他希望能加入我們一
行，拯救惡魔族免於毀滅的
linesZhCn: 『他说魔族已遭人以某种方式
操纵，他希望能加入我们一
行，拯救恶魔族免于毁灭的
linesEn: He says the demons are being controlled by someone,
and he wishes to join our party to save the demon race from ruin.
...He wants to fight alongside us.
Can demons truly be trusted? A lesser demon, no less...

linesZhTw: 軍者，都可以加入我們一行
linesZhCn: 军者，都可以加入我们一行
linesEn: It doesn't matter! Anyone with the heart to fight the Dark Army is welcome among us!
We have to place trust in others before we can expect their trust in return, don't we?

linesZhTw: 能得到別人的信任。不是嗎
linesZhCn: 能得到别人的信任。不是吗
linesEn: ...Isn't that right?
